universal.noAgent: Select an agent in the chat toolbar first
universal.noAgentHint: Agents and their jobs are authored in Agent Settings, from the profile menu.
universal.pickIntentHint: Open an intent to review its contract and start via chat or build.
universal.noIntents: This job declares no intents — every turn runs with its base prompt.
universal.intentAutonomousHint: Turns under this intent never ask a blocking question and proceed with sensible defaults.
universal.hooksAllHint: Every entry must hold when the turn stops (the stop event, AND), verified from actual tool results.
universal.hookArtifactMeaning: A real file write this turn must match this glob.
universal.hookActionMeaning: This tool must have been successfully called this turn.
universal.hooksNone: No hooks — the turn ends when the agent stops.
universal.hooksVerified: Checked at the turn's stop event, from actual tool results — never from the model's claims. Unmet hooks re-prompt the agent a bounded number of times, then pause the job resumably.
universal.buildDirective: Please run the "{{intent}}" intent. There is no further input beyond this request — treat the intent's own definition as the complete specification and carry it out end to end
universal.armedHint: Armed — this intent rides the next chat turn.
universal.intentNoPromptHint: No prompt file — this intent runs on the base prompts alone.
universal.intentPromptLoadError: Could not load prompt.md — open it in Agent Settings to read the file.
universal.openInSettingsAria: Open this intent in Agent Settings
